purpose: Exploratory, non-parametric no-attention/no-Mamba/no-TTT episodic content-addressed associative memory. This is a new G7 research candidate, NOT a claim of world-first novelty; count sketches and hash associative storage have prior art.

lineage.compare_to_s13: HISTORICAL_CONTEXT_ONLY, not same model, budget or exact sample distribution

mechanism.name: CATSEM - collision-aware tri-sketch episodic memory
mechanism.description: Direct event-marked pair writes to three independent bounded hash-bucket state arrays; query key code reads each bucket, picks minimum collision-occupancy sketch; no token-token softmax or dense sequence attention, and no learned weights.
mechanism.writer: read markers in first T-8 tokens; each true or distractor key token with marker32 must immediately precede value token with marker33; scatter_add value vectors and occupancy counts into key-indexed buckets.
mechanism.reader: query token marker34 in last eight slots; gather three independent bucket means and choose minimum-occupancy stream per query; state is reinitialized each episode; query cannot write.
mechanism.hash: Bitpack 16 signed binary key bits, 32-bit avalanche mixing with three independent fixed seeds; prime bucket sizes 1021,1031,1033; one-sketch control uses 1021. No learned content projection or continuous-key tolerance.
mechanism.memory_scaling: O(batch*16*(1021+1031+1033)) float32 for three 16-dim value sketches plus counts; independent of token sequence length, O(T*hashes*value_dim) writes, no O(T^2) query/key comparisons. The dense token input itself still costs O(T*64), not counted as sketch state.
mechanism.inductive_bias_disclosure: Uses privileged known marker structure, binary key encoding, and immediately paired key/value support events. Comparison with trained neural hybrid is NOT fair architectural superiority. It is an algorithmic alternative and engineering candidate to test before any native integration.

frozen_experiment.query_support_pair_permutation: same exact S9 source helper with deterministic nonidentity per-example permutations
frozen_experiment.decoy_rng: independent signed +/-1 decoy keys and values from Generator.manual_seed(heldout_seed+451231); force decoy keys not equal to any of 4 true support keys by flipping a differing bit; duplicates among decoy keys allowed and counted as collisions

falsifiers: any source pin, exact candidate, pinned torch package manifest or official s6 data generator drift
any duplicate original support key within episode
any incorrect marker pairing, query target input, future read/write leakage or reset failure
any query has zero valid bucket count
any bound exceeds frozen MSE, memory or wall limits
any changed dpkg inventory or required system installation

interpretation.science: No trainable learning, unfamiliar relationships, cold learned retention, generalized reasoning or SCIENTIFIC_PASS can be inferred. This is an algorithmic retrieval feasibility test only.
interpretation.next_if_positive: Add a trainable learned write/read gate and test continuous/noisy keys plus new relation composition against strong conventional and native controls with matched data, FLOPs, memory and wall time; only then consider hybrid attention substitution.

authority.execution: single-use read-only CPU experiment via existing TTT-HYBRID-GPU-WIN self-hosted runner, Ubuntu normal UID1000 and pinned already-installed R3 Python venv
